# Microsoft Word

Microsoft Word tools for finding, downloading, updating, and managing DOCX files in OneDrive and SharePoint through Microsoft Graph

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/microsoft-word/.

## Actions

- **Add Comment**: Add a Word comment to one exact paragraph selected by text or a READ_DOCX locator.
- **Append Content**: Append plain text or supported Markdown paragraphs, headings, formatted runs, lists, rectangular tables, safe http/https/mailto links, and…
- **Copy DOCX**: Copy a verified DOCX to a OneDrive or SharePoint folder, wait boundedly for the asynchronous operation, and return verified destination…
- **Create DOCX**: Create a safe DOCX containing styled paragraphs and formatted runs, bullet or decimal lists, rectangular tables, or constrained…
- **Create DOCX sharing link**: Create a view, edit, or embed sharing link for a verified DOCX.
- **Delete DOCX**: Move one DOCX to the provider recycle bin only when its current eTag matches.
- **Edit DOCX**: Atomically edit literal text, paragraphs, independent Latin/non-complex and complex-script run formatting, lists, rectangular tables…
- **Export DOCX to PDF** (read-only): Convert a DOCX of at most 2 MB to PDF through Microsoft Graph and return a temporary file reference.
- **Fill Template**: Fill run-spanning placeholders in main-document paragraphs of a validated DOCX template snapshot, then create and return a new document.
- **Find DOCX files** (read-only): Browse one folder or search a drive for DOCX files.
- **Find SharePoint sites** (read-only): Find accessible SharePoint sites by keyword, or resolve one known hostname and site path to its site ID.
- **Get Microsoft Word account context**: Return the signed-in Microsoft identity and primary OneDrive identifiers needed to start OneDrive DOCX work.
- **Invite DOCX recipients**: Grant read or write access to required named recipients.
- **List DOCX versions** (read-only): Validate the selected drive item as a DOCX, then return one page of retained versions in Microsoft Graph's newest-first order.
- **List OneDrive drives** (read-only): Return one page of drives available to the signed-in user as the Microsoft Word toolkit's OneDrive-drive selector for DOCX workflows.
- **List SharePoint document libraries** (read-only): Return one page of document libraries and available root folder item IDs for a SharePoint site ID.
- **Move or rename DOCX**: Rename a DOCX, move it within the same drive, or do both, guarded by its current eTag.
- **Read DOCX** (read-only): Safely inspect a DOCX as bounded rich OOXML.
- **Replace Text**: Replace literal text across Word run boundaries in a DOCX, optionally as tracked revisions.
- **Resolve Tracked Changes**: Accept or reject all pending tracked revisions, or selected revision locators returned by READ_DOCX.
- **Restore DOCX version**: Restore a retained DOCX version as a new current version, preserving version history, then observe the item's current metadata in a…
- **Upsert DOCX**: Create or replace a same-name DOCX containing the same validated content supported by CREATE_DOCX.
